sections.heading: Apologising
sections.body:
- *Perdón* / *Disculpa* (tú) / *Disculpe* (usted) — sorry, excuse me (small things, getting attention)
- *Lo siento (mucho)* — I'm (very) sorry (real regret)
- *Perdona / Perdone el retraso* — sorry for the delay
- *Fue sin querer* — I didn't mean to

Accepting an apology: *No pasa nada* (It's nothing / No worries), *No te preocupes* (Don't worry), *Tranquilo / Tranquila* (It's fine), *No importa* (It doesn't matter).

sections.heading: Congratulating and good wishes
sections.body:
- *¡Felicidades!* / *¡Felicitaciones!* — Congratulations! (for any good news)
- *¡Feliz cumpleaños!* — Happy birthday! *¡Que cumplas muchos más!* — Many happy returns!
- *¡Feliz Navidad! ¡Feliz Año Nuevo!* — Merry Christmas! Happy New Year!
- *¡Buen viaje!* (Have a good trip) *¡Buena suerte!* (Good luck) *¡Que te vaya bien!* (All the best) *¡Que te diviertas!* (Have fun) *¡Buen provecho!* (Enjoy your meal — said to people eating)

The replies: *¡Gracias! Igualmente* (You too).

sections.heading: Condolences and toasts
sections.body:
When someone dies: *Lo siento mucho* (I'm so sorry), *Mi más sentido pésame* (My deepest condolences — formal), *Te acompaño en el sentimiento*.

Toasting: raise your glass and say *¡Salud!* (Cheers! — also said when someone sneezes). For a speech: *¡Por los novios!* (To the bride and groom!) *¡Por nosotros!* (To us!)

vocab: the bride and groom / the couple
examples: Excuse me, can I get by?
Lo siento mucho, fue sin querer.
I'm so sorry, I didn't mean to.
Merry Christmas and Happy New Year!
